{"diagnosis":"Batch 13 delivered txn_ts as 13-digit epoch milliseconds instead of 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS' strings, so the TIMESTAMP cast fails. 1768629721000 ms is 2026-01-17 06:02:01 UTC, which fits the 06:00 start pattern of the other batches, so UTC is the right interpretation. The fix parses epoch-ms values with epoch_ms and casts the rest as before.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.88,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS
SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id,
       customer_id,
       CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id,
       CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount,
       ts AS txn_ts,
       CAST(ts AS DATE) AS txn_date
FROM (
  SELECT *,
         CASE WHEN regexp_matches(txn_ts, '^[0-9]{13}$') THEN epoch_ms(CAST(txn_ts AS BIGINT))
              ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS ts
  FROM raw_transactions
  WHERE status = 'POSTED'
) r;"}}
